name: metisclip-desktop
description: MetisClip Desktop: agentic AI video clipping (Windows)
author: MetisClip

scripts.dev: tsc -p tsconfig.json && concurrently -k -s first -n main,ui,app -c blue,magenta,green "npm:watch:main" "npm:dev:ui" "npm:dev:electron"
scripts.pack: npm run build:main && electron-builder --win dir --config electron-builder.yml
scripts.dist: npm run build:main && electron-builder --win nsis --config electron-builder.yml
